feed.title: The Documented Record — revisions
feed.subtitle: Every dated change to the record, in the words of the record itself. Figures move because the bodies that count them publish again; findings are added as courts and commissions make them.
feed.rights: The record cites its sources; each source carries its own terms.

entry.title: Current edition.
entry.content: Current edition. The record runs in twenty-four Parts with Appendices A to F, from the pre-state period (1917-1948) to October 2026. It carries the Gaza casualty series to 16 November 2026 (74,702 killed, 176,105 injured; 72,835 identified by name); the legal record (the ICJ's orders and advisory opinions, the ICC's warrants, the UN Commission of Inquiry's two genocide findings, and the apartheid findings of B'Tselem, Human Rights Watch and Amnesty International); the documented statements of intent; Hamas's 7 October 2023 war crimes by the same evidentiary standard (Part XVIII, including the Hannibal Directive at §18.6); the West Bank, settlement and annexation record (Parts IX and X); the argument that Zionism is racism, its evidence and the replies to its critics (§21.12, Rebuttal 27); the Hebron court-martial of 1982-83 (§5.3A); the Holborn and St Pancras by-election and the Green leadership's response (§21.10); Benjamin Moser (§23.3); Navi Pillay's Nobel Peace Prize and the sanctioning of the ICC itself (§15.13); the New York Times investigation of the US embassy's reports on the nine Americans (§15.5); the Royal College of Nursing and Teva UK (§15.7); Yocheved Lifshitz's account of her captivity (§18.1); the first year of the ceasefire and the loss of Gaza's land records (§6.7); the bodies of the dead and the organ allegations (§10.3B); the proposer of the Green motion and the investigation (§21.10); Avi Shlaim on the Arab Jews (§23.3); the New York Times of 20 June 1899 (§1.0); the hostages who died in captivity and the CNN investigation (§18.6); the covert campaign against the ICC (§15.13); the skin-bank allegation (§10.3B); the Lewinsky-tapes claim (§19.7); the Seinfeld show in Chicago (§15.9); the YouGov poll on the Greens and prejudice against Jewish people (§21.10); Burnham's ruling out of a partnership with the Greens and Polanski's reply (§21.10); Nick Maynard and Owen Jones on children shot (§10.7); Moser's further remarks (§23.3); Simon Schama's "blood libel" remarks and the public reply (§21.11); the Greens4Palestine press conference with Alnaouq and Karmi (§21.10); Jewish Israeli polling on Arab citizens and Palestinians, with Pew 2016, the Israeli Democracy Index 2022 and the Penn State survey of 2025 (§3.5D); the character of the three intifadas, with the Shin Bet, OCHA and PCPSR findings (§5.3); the MI5 files on Lehi's plots (§1.3); and the record on Israel and the Syrian jihadists (§11.2); the Commission of Inquiry's fifth report to the General Assembly, A/81/430, finding genocidal acts continuing in Gaza after the ceasefire and crimes against humanity in the West Bank (§10.7B); the Gaza ceasefire's second year, including the halt to commercial goods and the WFP cuts (§6.7); the Israeli election of 27 October 2026 and the claim that it was "stolen" (§4.5); the Hebron operation of 23 October, the West Bank closure and the record month of settler attacks (§9.6); statements by Ben-Gvir, Netanyahu, Strock and Smotrich (§6.2); the Board of Deputies' declaration that the Green Party is "a racist party" and a circulated Green reply (§21.10); the eve of the Supreme Court hearing on the Palestine Action ban, with 325 arrests on 31 October (§13.9A); the ICC after the Israeli election, the EU's inaction and the General Assembly's Palestinian Rights Committee (§15.13); and the Iran war and Lebanon at the end of October (§8.6); the Nasser Hospital strike of 12 November, the killing of a father and son in Zeitoun, the killing of the Rafah Brigade commander and the toll to mid-November, including the revision of the Ministry's child count to 21,976 (§6.7); the winter flood of 6-9 November, the closure of the Egyptian aid route, the Board of Peace's statement that Israel's response was insufficient, and a broadcaster's remark on the flooded tents (§6.12); the end of the Hebron operation, the Nachala takeover of eight homes in Jericho and the record month of settler attacks (§9.7); the mandate given to Eisenkot and the swearing-in of the 26th Knesset (§4.5); statements by Galili, Ganz and Katz (§6.2); the reserved judgment in the Palestine Action appeal (§13.9A); the NatCen survey on Britons' view of Israel as a threat to world peace (§15.10); the US poll and the announcement that US military aid would end (§15.11); the DC Studios change and the Ellison claim (§15.12); the travel ban on Al-Haq's director (§15.13); and the open letter of Jews Against Genocide Denial (§21.10); the ICJ's judgment in The Gambia v. Myanmar and the Policy Exchange paper on the genocide standard (§6.13), the first Israeli ground push since the ceasefire and the Board of Peace's second report (§6.7), the Special Rapporteur's media report A/81/249 (§15.9C), the Third Committee's vote on Palestinian self-determination (§15.1D), Channel 4's files on UK arms export licences (§13.3B), the petition of Britain Owes Palestine (§1.1), the Al-Shifa animation and the Rebuttal 25 addendum, the Board of Peace's warning of 20 November (§6.7), the E1 postponement (§9.7), the Jericho settler killing and the UK sanctions of 17 November (§9.7), the Eisenkot bloc (§4.5), the Gulf escalation (§8.6) and the new Congress (§15.11); Einstein's speech of 17 April 1938 and the binationalists Magnes, Buber and Ihud (§21.12.3); the Supreme Court's reversal of the disqualification of the Arab lists and the statehood question put to nine parties in the Israeli election campaign (§4.5); the strike on Reem Awad in Gaza City on 14 October 2026 (§6.7); Faber's decision to stop supplying Sally Rooney's books in the UK (§13.9A); and the record of Israeli official disinformation, including circulated claims the record cannot verify (§19.7). The dashboard at palestinerecord.github.io is built from this document.
